description: Draft shared threshold table (#583 roadmap v0.6, Integration architecture 2). Records the cutoff each side applies today for the same finding. 'engine' values AND comparators are verified against this tree by tests/test_diagnostic_thresholds.py: 'op_pattern' captures the shell comparator the script uses, and 'polarity' says whether that comparator tests for the finding ('direct') or for its opposite ('negated', e.g. 'elif -gt -75 then fair', so weak is <= -75). 'instant_test' values are cited from PrivacyGUI feat/instant-test-integration @ 6d7c6aaf and are not machine-checked here; null means no citation yet. 'agreed' is true only when both sides use the same comparator and value. 'decided' records a boundary chosen on #622 that the code does not yet implement everywhere. 'engine_pairs' holds rules the engine itself must apply identically. Nothing reads this table at runtime yet.
